speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza
text: asked 	the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources what steps have been or are being taken under the Transboundary Haze Pollution Act to prosecute errant companies which have caused or contributed to the serious levels of hazardous haze pollution that Singapore experienced in 2015.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Second, to discontinue, or not commence, any burning activities on such land.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Third, to submit to NEA any plan of action to extinguish any fire on such land or to prevent its recurrence.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: NEA also received information from APP following our earlier request for information.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: NEA has also written to its counterparts in the Ministry of Environment and Forestry, Indonesia, to seek their assistance in verifying some of the information provided by the two companies which have earlier responded to our Preventive Measures Notices.
